notes.title: MONKEY BARRELS Tips & Tricks!
notes.notes:
Now that you’ve had the chance to play MONKEY BARRELS, it’s time to introduce you to some fun tips that we found helpful:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/c297c5f3c15babb941f4cbd62f24057475497da4.jpg[/img]

[b]Know Your Enemy[/b]—Learn to recognize different enemies and pay attention to how they behave. For example, some do not fire projectiles, some do not pursue you directly, some are faster than others, some are stunned when they’re shot, and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/c7abf2c4d52792c1434adce75aafc698c5ef5a0b.png[/img]

Once you learn their patterns and tendencies, you’ll know which ones pose a greater (or more immediate) threat. Focus your firepower on the enemies you can’t avoid and the ones that can hurt you the most! After the bigger threats are eliminated, it’ll be easier to take out the rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/1238c24677e5e77506f1ee4af920e2c6903b1cb4.gif[/img]

[b]Jumping is the Key[/b]—Hanako and Masaru are fast and elusive, but sometimes the “bullet hell” patterns are too much for any monkey to handle. That’s where the Jump button comes into play: You can leap out of the way without taking any damage. It’s extremely important to learn how to attack while simultaneously dodging bullets with repeated jumps. In fact, the game’s developer, Good-Feel, says it’s the key to conquering MONKEY BARRELS! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/23f3ded8b14b2d01b46bfa5cf9e685f8c652a5d9.jpg[/img]

[b]Jump Ahead[/b]—If you press the Jump button while you’re moving, you’ll jump in the direction you’re moving… but if you press it while standing still, you’ll jump in the direction you’re facing instead. This can be useful when you need the jump to land on a specific spot, or if you’re just being careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/938a882949936ab8811cc0c1b20f62136d6b5083.png[/img]

[b]Use Wild Power[/b]—It’s tempting to save up your Wild Power for boss battles or areas with lots of enemies, but remember: Once your WP Gauge is full, you can’t earn any more until you use it up. You’ll pass up a lot of opportunities to get more Wild Power if you’re walking around for too long with a full WP Gauge, just sayin’!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/8a9a97283b7ca06142dec50fad3bf6de2aa32f99.jpg[/img]

[b]Secret Bonus[/b]—Having trouble with a certain stage? If you fail repeatedly, you may be offered the opportunity to continue with a +3 Life Gauge Bonus to make things a bit easier. Don’t be reluctant to take advantage of this offer—it’s not cheating, we won’t tell anybody!

We hope these tips can help you as well!

notes.title: MONKEY BARRELS: Go for a Ride!
notes.notes:
By now you should be aware that MONKEY BARRELS is an awesome twin-stick shooter that’s incredibly fun to play. But did you know that it has some stages where the monkeys get to ride on awesome vehicles? Check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/cfe2b313e312ed91ca239b6aca58704105ea10d4.png[/img]

In some stages, Masaru or Hanako gets behind the handlebars of a slick motorcycle to chase after Kotetsu at high speed. But just because you’re on a bike doesn’t mean the shooting stops—in fact, these stages play more like a scrolling shooter. You’ll need to blast plenty of enemies and obstacles that Crabbenwold places in your path!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/e18a1f66497861245c974256ff9019d1fe89d7ee.png[/img]

In other stages, the chimps get to commandeer a powerful tank. That’s right, it’s a real armored military powerhouse (albeit banana-colored). You’ll love driving around, blasting the cannon and rolling the treads over anything and everything in your path!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/3cb37e4d0e3caca547003ec751ecd0355b30e24d.png[/img]

But that’s not all! You can also fight big bosses while riding the motorcycle or tank. There’s even a couple of intense boss battles that take place while you’re standing on the top of a speeding train!

MONKEY BARRELS releases September 26—that’s next week! Watch this space for additional news stories, and remember to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: Go Ape in BANANA SCRAMBLE Mode Online!
notes.notes:
In addition to the ridiculously fun Story Mode, MONKEY BARRELS also features BANANA SCRAMBLE, a wild online PVP mode that can be enjoyed by four to six players.

[b]Please note:[/b] Banana Scramble will not be available until after you defeat the Chapter 1 boss in Story Mode. Once unlocked, the player will be able to enter Banana Scramble at any time from the Camp site.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/4a7223bec9eec56d3cc0b751badbc04473d15098.png[/img]

Before you enter the fray, you get to select your name, your character and your weapon loadout. You’ve got to be ready for anything, so choose carefully!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/0da4209445feff1585c6498ca60ad6fa7152ca90.png[/img]

The rules of Banana Scramble are quite simple: The monkey with the most bananas at the end of the match is the winner. You drop bananas when you get hit, so watch your back! Playing more Banana Scramble matches (and picking up more bananas) will increase your Monkey Rank, which helps the game to match you with players at your current skill and experience level.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/386e62575d15d5756e49d2676b3af8c20d7f3ccd.jpg[/img]

If you see a giant yellow box, try to blast it open to get tons of bananas... but your opponents can get them, too. Try different strategies to get that Number 1 spot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/14fb18a70b574c78f6de9456c04b1730d6de4dec.png[/img]

[b]PROTIP:[/b] There are certain weapons that can only be unlocked by playing Banana Scramble mode online. Don’t miss them! 

MONKEY BARRELS releases on September 26. Keep an eye out for more news in the coming weeks and be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: Can you handle WILD POWER?
notes.notes:
What is WILD POWER, you ask?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/71d3864d0bcf5695d781354c972205947ad08252.png[/img]

Your WP gauge fills up each time you take damage, defeat an enemy or drink WP Juice. When the gauge is filled, simply press the Wild button to activate WILD POWER mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/ccd676946c6645ba3c1bfe3c8ebfd8351d69e819.png[/img]

WILD POWER mode causes an explosion that wipes out nearby enemies and projectiles. After that, you’ll have increased attack power and unlimited ammo for your main weapons—with no reloading required!—until the WP gauge runs out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/d4dd239759a45e71724ff3042e6dca17e025cefc.gif[/img]

It’s best to unleash your WILD POWER when you really need help. It can get out of a dire situation, like when you’re surrounded, or when you’re facing a tough boss. But don’t wait too long, because once the WP gauge is filled, you can’t earn any more WP until it’s used up!

MONKEY BARRELS releases later this year on September 26! 
Keep an eye out for more information in the coming weeks and be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: MONKEY BARRELS: Weapons and Items!
notes.notes:
[b]Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/e7ab819ecc0bd3d4be6b4f37d9a4e9bafd967722.png[/img]

Did you know MONKEY BARRELS lets you use 98 outrageous weapons fashioned from household objects like bottles, cans, blow dryers, umbrellas and more?

These weapons are characterized in two different types: Main Weapons and Sub Weapons.

Main? Sub? What does that mean?! Check below to find out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/082df7d779c3d5df1ceb318197ef28d106157081.png[/img]

The Main Weapons fire projectiles. They automatically reload when empty, or you can reload manually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/f97163d6e4c979d5b28562ab333de0aaac13a4a9.png[/img]

Sub Weapons include timed explosives, shields and more. They are replenished only when you pick up Ammo.

Players can equip up to four weapons simultaneously (two Main Weapons and two Sub Weapons), so be sure to experiment and find the ones that best suit your playing style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/cb4b495d13f7349304c7d14c0cec697e6f7c4392.png[/img]

Not all weapons are available from the get-go. In order to unlock new weapons, you’ll need to bring a certain something to the talented inventor Mr. Shibayama. Keep reading to find out what that something is…

[b]ITEMS[/b]

As you destroy enemies and obstacles, you will uncover many useful items.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/981d21a6f048f7ac53a3598e5b6ddbc48bb93099.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/2cd2b9aaa52efc05539d34b49be8f4b30f402435.png[/img][/url]

Bananas fill up the Life gauge when you need it.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/28a7bfdaac4d17b5c87052fff48e0b1b943bef85.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/f19a83e6647cf89c0f575bb3ec3d6ec28c5dd598.png[/img][/url]

Ammo Boxes refill both of your Sub Weapons to max capacity.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/4befe82a7b31dfc947cd0fca831612204d245fb8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/293264f8dfa0f0748a04117494021141f5b814c9.png[/img][/url]

WILD POWER Juice Cans fill up your WP gauge (we’ll get more in detail on this next week!)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/e43787a2bb9a388a3c0eb5ea095f942174627915.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/a228d5a8e2eca46f402f6c987b1aad687c7007c8.png[/img][/url]

Junk can be exchanged for new weapons at the Shop.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/ea3d933d976a5c8a7a285ac437675c6a933d793c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/9a3214c3d912e12e1bc2dce6fa0143f096216f26.png[/img][/url]
Crabbenwold Gate Keys unlock gates that block your progress.

Some items are hidden throughout the stages as well. Take for example, Weapon Blueprints.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/ab9ea282ac9913de788f96b6e6c5118a2f1e1cfb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/8cd1b040ea8b3b39feb32387a37472131f21a22e.png[/img][/url]

Blueprints unlock weapons in Shibayama’s Shop Inventory, so be sure to bring them to Mr. Shibayama when you find them!

That’s all for this week, fellow primates!

MONKEY BARRELS releases later this year on September 26! 
Keep an eye out for more information in the coming weeks, and be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: MONKEY BARRELS Story
notes.notes:
The crazy twin-stick shooter MONKEY BARRELS features a challenging STORY MODE with exciting CHARACTERS. Here’s a quick preview of the STORY:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/6d56f0d4d2c1d0b6ecf05945af27dcf247f1752d.png[/img]

With a secret “combat chip,” global consumer electronics manufacturer [b]Crabbenwold Electric[/b] weaponized ordinary household appliances and destroyed all human life on Earth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/6485e428500b24e7293b418f70e8c5b49e17e53d.png[/img]

Now Dr. Crabbenwold’s sinister airship descends from the skies over Tokyo! His plan? To capture innocent monkeys for his “military animals” experiments... starting with little Kotetsu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/29989402d28e9bf588f54acd1f69e4d63ab7a2fd.png[/img]

Two brave monkeys named [b]Masaru[/b] and [b]Hanako[/b] vow to rescue their friend. But first, their mentor, [b]Mr. Shibayama[/b] must teach them how to use the crazy weapons he’s invented…

Let’s take a closer look at each of the main CHARACTERS:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/62cd4975209642182aee890ae16624b14b94b1c0.gif[/img]
Affable, passionate and impulsive, MASARU loves his biker jacket! His helmet is covered in stickers that he collected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/636f5fcf925efa1f7faf93215572d037c47e61e8.gif[/img]
Tough and high-spirited, HANAKO was once a local celebrity at Ueno Zoo’s Monkey Mountain. Now she roams free in a world without humans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/dee0e1c3ec6cd0da1e876db112a4cbd05aa593bd.gif[/img]
Kind, thoughtful and speedy KOTETSU threw himself in front of Hanako to save her from Crabbenwold’s claw. He must be rescued!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/05ff7758807a9ad092af43ea03d2664932178982.gif[/img]
Stylish genius gorilla MR. SHIBAYAMA builds weapons for Masaru and Hanako and guides them through their rescue mission. He’s a huge Oedo Professional Wrestling fan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/3c735e44c2c4bcf269658c052504ffde983feb55.gif[/img]
The sinister DR. ECHIZEN CRABBENWOLD weaponized household electronics to wipe out the human race. Now he plans to perform military experiments on innocent animals!

MONKEY BARRELS releases later this year on September 26! 
Keep an eye out for more information in the coming weeks and be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: Announcing MONKEY BARRELS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/eb7f090db03d058fe6052294be714f44e3f986d2.jpg[/img]

A labor of love by renowned developer Good-Feel from Japan, MONKEY BARRELS is a top-down twin-stick action shooter featuring unique “3D pixel art” that puts a fresh spin on old-school graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817766/c297c5f3c15babb941f4cbd62f24057475497da4.jpg[/img]

If you’re a fan of The Binding of Isaac series, this is your next must-play game—you’ll love the smooth twin-stick controls and the huge variety of weapons and items!
